source: bot_55chat_daemon.py 账务逻辑 + docs/用户使用.md §2 §4
panel_authority: 余额、编号、流水、账单以控制面板 users/bills 为准
identity: 认人 messengerId；群昵称仅显示

flow: 3. 群主面板同意 → balance += amount
1. 校验 balance >= amount，否则余额不足
4. 群主面板同意 → balance -= amount

bet_place.cost_formula: total_cost = sum(unit_stake for each pick in order)
pre_check: 单注/当期个人/群类别限额通过

functions.lane: calc_lane_payout(code, picks, unit, draw) — 单点×9.63 或 大小单双×1.924
functions.pc28: calc_pc28_payout(picks, unit, final_result) — 点杀表/大小单双/组合；1314特殊赔率
functions.mark6: calc_mark6_payout(picks, unit, draw) — 特码/头尾/生肖/波色/五行/组合

bet_payout.credit: balance += payout（按注逐笔 calc_bet_payout 汇总）
bet_payout.push_principal: mark6 5-0/0-0 → payout = unit × len(picks) 退本
bet_payout.pc28_1314_combo: 小单/大双 1314 → 退本(unit)；大小单双 → 1.6倍

cancel.rule: 封盘前可取消当期待结算注单

rebate.rule: 仅提交申请文案；实际发放由群主核实流水后手动/面板操作

payout_formulas.pc28_combo_a: 小单/大双: unit × (1 if 1314 else 4.58)

settle_accounting.max_payout_guard: 单期派彩合计不超过 LIMIT_ROUND_PAYOUT
